posts.name: Estelindis
posts.cooked:
Chokepoint looks amazing.  I think it's fair to say that the criticisms that could be levelled at the design of Mindphyre don't apply across the board, and certainly not to the examples of character design that we've seen today.  (Okay: Chokepoint's outfit is strapless, but sure no one would argue it's not supportive!  It's armour!)

I am really interested to see who Chokepoint's nemesis might be.  Might she have multiple nemeses in K.N.Y.F.E., Bunker and Unity?  On the other hand, maybe the multiple nemesis thing should be a unique aspecy of Iron Legacy.  Rook City is Wraith's home, but only one of its villains is her nemesis.  A strong thematic and/or story link doesn't have to make characters nemeses.

I think the Celectial Tribunal is evocative of the Reapers of Mass Effect.  GtG have done some really interesting things with environments lately.  The Tribunal might work just as well as a villain.
